faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DEO Malkangiri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DEO Malkangiri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 31 vacancies: 24 Guest Faculty (+2 Arts), 7 Guest Faculty (+2 Science).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DEO Malkangiri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to Office of the respective Principal / Headmaster of the Govt. Higher Secondary Schools, by by hand or in person to the undersigned, to reach by 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: At least 50% marks or equivalent grade in Master's Degree in the subject concerned along with B.Ed. or Equivalent Degree for B.Ed. subjects recognized by NCTE, New Delhi. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Certificate verification. Selection on the basis of educational career, teaching experience and basic computer knowledge (DCA/PGDCA). Selection on the basis of educational career, teaching experience and basic computer knowledge (Either DCA/PGDCA) in computer application. Certificate verification in the office of the school head on 12-11-2026, 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

faq.question: Q6. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement as guest faculty for the session 2026-2027.
